listing: Enjoy the beauty of a sunset from Flat 1

reviews.name: Stewart
reviews.text: The flat was easy to find, and so much more bigger than anticipated. Great view and the garden at the back was serene and beautiful. Steph and her son Matteo were very helpful and friendly. I can't recommend this place and hosts enough!

reviews.name: Simeon
reviews.text: Nice and good accommodation. Spacious apartment and nice views. An extra plus for the personal and nice tourist brochure that Stephanie's son put together.

reviews.name: Emma
reviews.text: Immaculate, had everything you needed. Courtyard fantastic with a lovely lemon tree. Easy to find, plenty of on-street parking. Very spacious with a bathroom and separate shower. Fantastic host! Nothing was too much!

reviews.name: Juli
reviews.text: Lovely and LARGE place; nicer in person than imagined. Stephanie greeted me at arrival, showed the space and left me alone. 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, nice kitchen. Balcony and patio fantastic and the view!! Hot water heater deserves its own 5 stars.

reviews.name: Chantal
reviews.text: Spotlessly clean, bright, very spacious. Beautifully maintained garden with fruit trees. Location perfect. Hosts very kind, warm, responsive. Perfect for a longer holiday. Will definitely come back.

reviews.name: Piotr
reviews.text: The best choice in Malta! Apartment much bigger than in photo. Amazing view. Lemon trees in garden. Local shops a few minutes' walk. Easy parking. Not far from Gozo + Comino. Absolutely perfect.

reviews.name: Matthias
reviews.text: Really great! Superbly equipped kitchen, great view. Adapters and everything else provided. The way to the beach takes a while, but that's not a problem.

reviews.name: Matthew
reviews.text: Stephanie very welcoming. Flat very nice and clean with stunning views of Mellieha. Will definitely stay again.

reviews.name: Angela Grazia
reviews.text: Very spacious, well-ventilated, bright. UNCOMFORTABLE BED. Washing machine WITHOUT DETERGENT.
reviews.host_response: Stephanie: mattress is brand new orthopaedic; comfort varies person to person. Detergent not included as guests often prefer their own products.

reviews.name: Cassie
reviews.text: Really enjoyed; highlight the beautiful view at golden hour. Stephanie super responsive, smooth check-in. MAKE SURE YOU HAVE COINS FOR THE AIRCON. Be aware the flat is at the TOP OF A BIG HILL WITH LOADS OF STEPS if arriving from the bus stop with luggage. THE BEDS AND PILLOWS WEREN'T THE MOST COMFORTABLE so we didn't get the best night's sleep. Good base for first time in Malta.

reviews.name: Renaud
reviews.text: Spacious, nice view for sunrise/sunset. Easy to park near the accommodation.

reviews.name: Alberto
reviews.text: Very large; two twin bedrooms and one double. Two bathrooms, one with washing machine. Garden in back for BBQ. Beautiful wide view of the church and Comino/Gozo. Quiet area, close to shops/restaurants. Easy parking. Couldn't have made a better choice.

reviews.name: Lucrezia
reviews.text: Very responsive host. Beautiful area, quiet and safe; wonderful view of the sea and sunset from the terrace.

reviews.name: Elisa
reviews.text: Large and spacious with spectacular views; children saw the sunset from the kitchen every night. Responsive and helpful host. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Scott
reviews.text: My grandparents stayed and loved it. Stephanie welcoming and friendly.

reviews.name: Katrin
reviews.text: Friendly host; able to check in earlier. Apartment as described, everything you need, very clean. Would go again and again.

reviews.name: Giorgio
reviews.text: Excellent location, quiet, beautiful sea + old-town view. Clean and comfortable. Extremely helpful host. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Scott
reviews.text: Stephanie very friendly and kind; great place to stay in Mellieha.

reviews.name: Alan
reviews.text: Great apartment. Just as described, especially suitable for families.

reviews.name: Zhivka
reviews.text: Pleasantly surprised how nice it was. Photos do not capture the stunning balcony view. Clean, basic amenities. Quiet area. Loved the balcony and garden.

reviews.name: Filip
reviews.text: Very spacious and nice! Couldn't get enough of the balcony view - perfect for reading. Clean towels/beds, clear instructions. Under 10-min walk to stores and cafes/restaurants.
